description: This file contains utility functions for session management, string manipulation, parameter retrieval, encryption mapping, time conversions, subnet table fetching, and other miscellaneous helpers used within a larger web-based network management system.

methods.name: php_getstr
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving session-based string values with PSM mode checks.

methods.name: php_getinstanceids
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving instance IDs with PSM mode considerations.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Retrieves key-value pairs from a root object and parameter array, returning a mapping with object IDs as keys.

methods.name: encrypt_map
methods.description: Maps encryption modes and methods to human-readable descriptions.

methods.name: getLeafName
methods.description: Extracts leaf parameter name from a full DM path string.

methods.name: getObjIdInPath
methods.description: Extracts object ID from a DM path based on the root object.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameters' values for multiple objects from DM, filtering by specified keys.

methods.name: init_psmMode
methods.description: Generates notification page content if PSM Mode is enabled.

methods.name: php_str_and
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND on two hex string inputs, limited to 16 hex characters.

methods.name: array_trim
methods.description: Removes front and tail whitespace and empty strings from array elements.

methods.name: fetchAdditionalSubnetTable
methods.description: Fetches additional subnet configuration entries from DM, returning an array or null on error.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Reads default configuration values from an XML file based on specified keys.

methods.name: div_sub
methods.description: Performs division by repeated subtraction, returning quotient and remainder.

methods.name: hm_to_sec
methods.description: Converts time in H:M format to total seconds.

methods.name: sec_to_hm
methods.description: Converts seconds into H:M time format.

methods.name: shift_blockedDays
methods.description: Shifts list of blocked days forward or backward in the week.

methods.name: group_2D_array
methods.description: Groups a list of associative arrays into nested groups based on specified fields.

methods.name: local_to_UTC_Time
methods.description: Converts local time and days to UTC time considering timezone offset, returning time, days, and a flag for day change.

methods.name: UTC_to_local_Time
methods.description: Converts UTC time and days to local time based on timezone offset.

methods.name: UTC_to_local_date_logs
methods.description: Converts UTC time to local date/time string for logs.

methods.name: time_in_min
methods.description: Converts time string H:M to total minutes.

methods.name: cmp
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting items by StartTime.

methods.name: merge_days
methods.description: Merges sequential time intervals if they are contiguous.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_get
methods.description: Transforms days/time data into local time and groups based on specified key fields.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_set
methods.description: Converts local times back to UTC times for rule setting, handling day changes.

methods.name: time_date_conflict
methods.description: Checks for overlapping time and date ranges.

methods.name: resolve_IPV6_global_address
methods.description: Decides the appropriate IPv6 global address from provided options.

methods.name: ProcessLay1Interface
methods.description: Converts Layer1Interface string to human-readable network connection type and network type.

methods.name: get_wan_type
methods.description: Determines WAN type as 'DOCSIS' or 'EPON' based on device characteristics.
